name: Inspect the public sample
description: Loads the built-in evidence slice through the inspect route and shows the focused symbol.
expected: authenticateUser and src/auth.ts are visible, with the objective Explain authenticateUser.

name: Reject a broken export
description: A non-export paste is refused and does not become a walkthrough.
expected: A visible inspection error is shown and no stale source report or authenticateUser is shown.

name: Walk through the loaded slice
description: After inspection, the walkthrough shows the related call.
expected: src/controller.ts is listed with calls and semantic.

name: Read the extension install path
description: The extension screen states the unpacked install and the loopback link rule.
expected: Load unpacked is visible and the page says a local link must be http://127.0.0.1:PORT/#token.
